title: Below-threshold Bistability and Implementation Lag in a Simplex Model of Radical Vote-Share Dynamics
summary: We study a nonautonomous compartmental model on the probability simplex for radical vote-share dynamics under delayed policy implementation. The model distinguishes a target regime from an effective regime that adjusts with finite speed and includes a persistent alienation reservoir that can later be mobilised by radical actors.
